title: Open Montage launches free AI video studio with 11 #OpenMontage #AgenticVideo #AIproduction
description: Open Montage launched the first agentic video production system that transforms Claude Code into a full production studio for free. Users simply describe their video in plain English, and the AI handles research, scripting, voiceovers, visuals, and editing through 11 built-in production pipelines. The system integrates 49 tools and over 400 agent skills, performing live web searches to ensure videos are based on up-to-date content from platforms like YouTube and Reddit. It supports multiple video types, including animated explainers, cinematic trailers, product ads, and podcast clips, streamlining creative production without the need for API keys. By enabling professional-quality video creation at minimal cost and with local, free tool access, Open Montage is poised to disrupt content production workflows and democratize video marketing for creators and businesses alike. #OpenMontage #ClaudeCode #AgenticVideoProduction #AIVideoTools #CinematicTrailers #VideoMarketing #ContentCreation #AIEditing #ProductAds #PodcastClips #TechInnovation #CreativeAI #VideoProductionSystem #FreeAIVideo #AutomationTools
